svg.title: Figure 1 | From problem to verification, with revision where needed
svg.desc: ↻ When a problem is found, return to the appropriate stage, revise, implement again and retest. Arrows indicate reading order. This diagram provides a reading sequence for beginners. Actual engineering is iterative: implementation, requirements clarification and testing can happen repeatedly.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
